text.en:
All technical personnel of the National Museum under the following categories are hereby
authorized to receive monthly incentive allowances as follows:
Chief of SectionP 300.00
Research Assistant300.00
Assistant Researcher400.00
Researcher without Ph.D.500.00
Sr. Researcher without Ph. D.600.00
Researcher with Ph.D. & Publications1,000.00
Sr. Researcher Ph.D. & Publication1,000.00
Curator (Chief of Division)1,000.00
Assistant Director1,200.00

The sum of eight hundred fifty-eight thousand pesos which shall be taken from any savings of
the National Museum for Calendar Year 1978 is hereby authorized to be paid for the above incentives.
Thereafter, the said amount shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.

All decrees, laws, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed,
modified or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect January 1, 1978.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
